keywords: Contract agreement, Equal contract 2.Designer, Construction manager, Technician 3.Management 4.Regional Cooperation 5.Career Design
educationalGoal: The construction industry is characterized by moving from place to place, producing a given product, and starting production after receiving an order. Although the scale of work handled is large, there is no prototype process. It is a labor intensive industry that relies on specialized technology. In this course, students learn about the image of engineers that society seeks and the obligation to consider the abilities needed to become an engineer. It also leads to personal career design.
advice: The production system in the construction industry is complex. The engineers engaged in the industry and the companies they belong to are diverse. The lecture content is designed to help students understand the current state of the construction industry, with a focus on the practical work of engineers.
requiredKnowledge: Interest in the construction industry. Students should have researched and generally understand the type of work they want to do.

activityGoals.body: To be able to express one's own opinion on the current state of the construction industry and future initiatives
Systematically understand the construction industry and the role of engineers.
Understand the importance of architectural schemes, which define the direction of projects.
Understand the work flow and duties of a design engineer.
Understand the work flow and duties of a construction engineer.
